name: prguard
description: PRGuard - AI slop detector for GitHub code review workflows.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @prguard/scoring run build && npm --workspace @prguard/api run build && npm --workspace @prguard/web run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace @prguard/scoring run test && npm --workspace @prguard/api run test
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @prguard/scoring run lint && npm --workspace @prguard/api run lint && npm --workspace @prguard/web run lint
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run evaluate
